The Fortrea clinical research unit (CRU) in Madison, Wisconsin, is a 30,000-square-foot, purpose-built clinic with 88 beds and more than 50 years of experience conducting Phase I trials with healthy participants, including absorption, metabolism and excretion (AME), first-in-human (FIH) and complex study designs.
